column2: *** ALMOST CERTAINLY ROQUE **LUIS** ARMANDO LERENA, aged 3 ***
column9: Line 18 - the line directly below his mother. 'Mast.' = Master, i.e. a boy. Roque Luis was born at Cape Town 25 Nov 1905, so he was three. The 1950 estate calls him 'LOUIS LERENA, major son'.

*** Occupation HOUSEWIFE. Address in Britain: 'C/O DALLING, FORE ST, NORTHAM, DEVON' - her elder sister Isabella Temple 'Edie' Taylor married a DALLING. Master C H Brocq, ship no. 129074. Item 30, line 5. ***

column2: Wife of Pablo Armando - the return leg
column9: *** She was in England five weeks. She died 15 Nov 1935, four and a half months after sailing home. Master A O Morgan, ship no. 118350, 266 passengers. ***

column2: *** GRANDDAUGHTER OF PABLO ARMANDO - Roque's daughter ***
column9: *** Occupation BALLET TEACHER, single. Address in Britain: 'VICOSA, WESTWARD HO, N DEVON' - the village adjoining NORTHAM, where her grandmother Mary Septima was born and baptised. She went to the Taylor country. She married at Portsmouth in 1961 and appears in Roque's 1973 estate as Juanita Ramond HUTSON (born Lerena). ***

*** OCCUPATION: DIPLOMATIC. Married. Future country of residence IRAN - an Argentine diplomat in transit to a posting. Travelling with Nelly Maria Delvalle Lerena (b.1922), Carlos GILBERTO Lerena (b.1946) and Eleonora Lerena (b.1947). Address Hotel Cumberland, London. ***
